# JUnit 5 + REST Assured Orders API example

A small Java API test example for a hypothetical Orders contract. Source files are under `src/test/java/example/orders/`.

The examples require JUnit Jupiter and REST Assured to already be available in the consuming project's test classpath. Set `API_BASE_URL` to an isolated test API before running. These files have not been compiled or run against a service; their example status codes and response fields must be checked against the real contract before reuse.
